data.current_description:
The `flightsFuture` endpoint retrieves detailed flight schedule information, including departures and arrivals, for dates more than 7 days after the current date (e.g., if today is 2025-08-22, the requested date must be after 2025-08-29).
                         
Simply attach the `iataCode`, `type`, `date` parameters to your API request URL. Set any date to future in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.     
      
      
   **Note:** *Flight blocks within a codeshared block take precedence over those outside it for filtering purposes. So, if there is a flight block inside codeshared, then it will search the query param to match in this `codeshared>flight>iataNumber`. If codeshared block is not present then it will refer to the `flight>iataNumber`.*   
   
   **Note:** *The `/timetable` and `/flightsfuture` endpoints have rate limits of 1 request every 10 seconds for Paid Plans and 1 request every 60 seconds for Free Plans, and exceeding these limits may result in throttling. Also, we don't include very low-traffic airports—like CDT, which has around 10 or fewer flights per day—in our feeds.*.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve flight schedules for dates 7+ days in future
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves detailed flight schedule information for dates more than 7 days in the future (minimum 8 days from current date). Required parameters: `iataCode` (airport IATA code), `type` (departure or arrival), and `date` (YYYY-MM-DD format). Supports optional filtering by airline, flight number, and aircraft type. Returns paginated list of flight objects with complete schedule details. Codeshared flights take precedence in filtering. Rate limited to 1 request per 10 seconds (Paid Plans) or 1 request per 60 seconds (Free Plans). Note: Very low-traffic airports (fewer than 10 flights daily) are excluded from the feed.

data.current_description:
The `flightsFuture` endpoint retrieves detailed flight schedule information, including departures and arrivals, for dates more than 7 days after the current date (e.g., if today is 2025-08-22, the requested date must be after 2025-08-29).
                         
Simply attach the `iataCode`, `type`, `date` parameters to your API request URL. Set any date to future in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.     
      
      
   **Note:** *Flight blocks within a codeshared block take precedence over those outside it for filtering purposes. So, if there is a flight block inside codeshared, then it will search the query param to match in this `codeshared>flight>iataNumber`. If codeshared block is not present then it will refer to the `flight>iataNumber`.*   
   
   **Note:** *The `/timetable` and `/flightsfuture` endpoints have rate limits of 1 request every 10 seconds for Paid Plans and 1 request every 60 seconds for Free Plans, and exceeding these limits may result in throttling. Also, we don't include very low-traffic airports—like CDT, which has around 10 or fewer flights per day—in our feeds.*.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve flight schedules for dates 7+ days in future
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves detailed flight schedule information for dates more than 7 days in the future (minimum 8 days from current date). Required parameters: `iataCode` (airport IATA code), `type` (departure or arrival), and `date` (YYYY-MM-DD format). Supports optional filtering by airline, flight number, and aircraft type. Returns paginated list of flight objects with complete schedule details. Codeshared flights take precedence in filtering. Rate limited: 1 request per 10 seconds (Paid Plans) or 1 request per 60 seconds (Free Plans). Note: Very low-traffic airports (fewer than 10 flights/day) are excluded from feeds.
